extra.reason: Removed html.unescape() call in md_to_html (workflow/main.py); regression test added in tests/test_main.py confirming old code executed injected <script> and new code does not.

html.escape() added at all five HTML sinks (chapter nav, title, chapter list, file list, repo name); mermaid_label() charset-restriction helper added for abstraction names and relationship labels in build_mermaid(). Tests added in tests/test_main.py.

Added DEFAULT_SKIP_NAMES/DEFAULT_SKIP_SUFFIXES denylist checked first in utils/crawl.py's _wanted(). Tests in tests/test_crawl.py cover both filename and suffix rejection plus list_files() end-to-end exclusion.
list_files() now rejects any path whose os.path.realpath() falls outside the repo root's realpath, closing the symlink escape. Regression test in tests/test_crawl.py.

Pinned mermaid@11.17.2 with an SRI sha384 hash computed directly from the downloaded file, plus crossorigin attribute and mermaid securityLevel: strict. Regression test asserts the script tag stays pinned and carries an integrity hash.

Wrapped the untrusted codebase/manifest content in each of the four prompts/*.md templates with an explicit untrusted-data boundary and an instruction to ignore embedded directives; identify-abstractions.md also states the abstraction-name charset constraint. Test in tests/test_prompts.py checks the boundary is present in every template and that templates still render.

All 6 child stories fixed, tested, and closed: stored XSS removed, HTML sinks/mermaid labels escaped, credential denylist added to crawler, symlink escape closed, mermaid CDN pinned with SRI, prompt-injection boundary added to all four prompt templates.

Fixed in commit b2bc4fb: SmartCrawl.prep now caps the number of files fed into the manifest to budget // chars_per_file instead of shrinking chars_per_file toward an 800-char floor, so manifest size no longer grows linearly with repo size. Test: tests/test_nodes.py::test_smart_crawl_caps_file_count_to_budget.

Fixed in commit b2bc4fb: SmartCrawl.post enforces a CODEBASE_BUDGET (default 1M chars, overridable via shared['codebase_budget']), dropping lowest-priority selected files once exceeded. Test: tests/test_nodes.py::test_smart_crawl_post_enforces_codebase_budget.

Fixed in commits b2bc4fb and 101d2e1: SmartCrawl/Analyze/Relate now route through utils.yaml_call (retries vary the prompt tail, defeating the sha256(prompt)-keyed cache) instead of the local parse_yaml duplicate. Also resolves coderay-pdi's cache/retry portion -- noted there. Test: tests/test_nodes.py::test_analyze_retry_sends_a_different_prompt_each_time verifies retries actually send distinct prompts.

Cheap fix landed in b2bc4fb: WriteChapters.exec now caps carried context to a fixed window of recent chapters (CHAPTER_CONTEXT_WINDOW=3, overridable via shared['chapter_context_window']) instead of accumulating full text of every prior chapter, bounding O(N^2) growth. NOT done: the structural fix for coarse retry granularity (one node per chapter, or a BatchNode threading a running summary so a bad response doesn't discard all prior chapters on retry) -- that's a bigger change that trades away narrative continuity and needs a decision with Mark, not a silent change. Deferring that part.

Fixed in commit c9ac496: call_llm now checks stop_reason=='max_tokens' (Anthropic), finish_reason=='length' (OpenAI), and finish_reason not STOP (Gemini) and raises on truncation; picks the first text-type content block from Anthropic instead of blindly indexing content[0] (which can be a thinking block); and raises RuntimeError on any falsy response text after dispatch so nothing bad gets cached. Tests in tests/test_call_llm.py cover the Anthropic truncation and thinking-block cases.

Fixed in commit c9ac496: cache key now folds in LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (_cache_path takes max_out), and _cache_put writes via tempfile.mkstemp + os.replace instead of writing in place. Tests: tests/test_call_llm.py::test_cache_key_changes_with_max_output_tokens and test_cache_put_leaves_no_temp_files_behind.

Fixed in commit b2bc4fb: Analyze.exec's normalize() now checks len(names)==len(set(names)) explicitly and compares sorted(names)==sorted(order), so a duplicate name can no longer pass a set-equality check that discards duplicates. Tests: tests/test_nodes.py::test_analyze_rejects_duplicate_abstraction_names and test_analyze_accepts_matching_names_and_order.

Fixed in commit b128844: list_files wraps os.path.getsize in try/except OSError: continue, and safe_read's caught exceptions widened from (UnicodeDecodeError, PermissionError) to (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) so a dangling symlink is skipped instead of crashing the whole walk. Tests: tests/test_crawl.py::test_safe_read_returns_none_on_broken_symlink and test_list_files_skips_broken_symlink_instead_of_crashing.

Fixed in commit b128844: safe_read takes an optional max_chars param (f.read(max_chars)) so SmartCrawl.prep no longer reads whole files just to slice a preview. Test: tests/test_crawl.py::test_safe_read_reads_only_max_chars.

Deferring, not implementing -- per the issue's own text: cache invalidation logic is correct and not masking bugs, rm -rf utils/.cache is already the documented escape hatch, and eviction should only be added if disk usage becomes a real problem. Adding TTL/size-cap logic now would be speculative (no reported disk-usage issue), so leaving it as a follow-up if that changes.

All 10 child stories fixed, tested, and closed: preview-budget floor and codebase-size cap enforced (both P0), LLM cache/retry defect fixed via yaml_call routing, WriteChapters context window capped, truncated/empty responses now raise, cache key/atomicity fixed, duplicate-name detection fixed, symlink/safe_read crawler robustness fixed. Cache eviction (P3) evaluated and declined per its own issue text.
